start: Watch with Always-on display OFF and Battery Saver off; a workout open on the phone; MettleUp on the watch screen

steps.action: Log a set and lower the wrist (or leave the screen untouched for the watch's screen timeout)
user_sees: About 1 s after the wrist goes down the screen drops to its lowest brightness
The same screen in black with outlined numbers (the rest countdown keeps ticking)

steps.action: Raise the wrist, or tap the screen, or turn the crown
user_sees: The screen is bright again with the same screen
must_not: The first tap presses a button such as Skip or -15 (it must only wake the screen)

steps.action: Finish the workout on the phone
user_sees: 'Workout saved', then the screen is let go and turns off by the watch's own timeout
must_not: The screen kept on after the workout ended

start: Watch with Always-on display ON; a workout open; MettleUp on screen

user_sees: The watch's own dim screen (the same black, outlined screen)
must_not: The app also keeps the screen on itself while Always-on is on
A flicker between two dim screens
The watch face instead of MettleUp

start: Watch with Always-on OFF and Battery Saver ON; a workout open

steps.action: Lower the wrist and wait for the watch's timeout
user_sees: The screen turns off as the watch normally does in Battery Saver
must_not: The app keeps the screen on against Battery Saver
An error or a message asking to change a watch setting

start: Always-on OFF; a workout open and dimmed by the app

steps.action: Pause the workout timer on the phone
user_sees: The watch screen is let go at once and turns off by the watch's timeout
must_not: The screen kept on dimmed for hours while paused

steps.action: Resume the workout on the phone and raise the wrist
user_sees: The screen is held and dims again instead of going black
must_not: The screen stays let go after the workout is resumed

steps.action: Leave the watch untouched for 12 minutes
user_sees: The screen is let go (idle) and goes off
must_not: The screen held on for up to 4 h with no one using it

user_sees: Bright again, and held (dimmed later) again
must_not: The screen never held again until the app is reopened

start: Member who sent the watch's screen log through Help and feedback

steps.action: Do a workout with the screen dimming; on the phone open Help and feedback and add the watch's screen log
user_sees: The caption says the log holds only the screen's on, off and dim times and the Battery Saver and screen settings
must_not: Workout names, weights, heart rate or location in the log
